verdict.rationale: MX offers free, self-serve developer API keys in the Client Dashboard and four test institutions for linking sandbox accounts. It also publishes an OpenAPI spec that can be imported into Postman, plus Web and React Native SDKs for embedding the Connect Widget. The evidence does not show a runnable end-to-end quickstart or server-side client libraries across languages, so developers likely have to work from the spec and Postman. Missing for 10: a documented runnable quickstart from signup to first linked account, official server-side client libraries in multiple languages, and independent evidence on time-to-first-link.
